about: SEARCHED-PARK MEMORY (KPC owner, 2026-11-12: do not search the same park again). ref -> searches: date, search (outline = a layer/boundary hunt; pin = an official-point hunt), result (found-source / official-pin / hand-download / nothing-found), where. The park detective and the GIS hunter skip a park whose OUTLINE was searched within 90 days unless a newer probe-able queue row exists for its area (.github/scripts/kpc_searched.py). Outside search passes: hand them this file first.
